The paper discusses the system in the context of the sdB eclipsing binary population, and notes that while the current data are consistent with a short-period sdB+M-dwarf architecture, a phase-resolved spectrum is needed to independently confirm the sdB identification.

entries.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning for JWST Galaxy Images and Low Resolution Spectra
entries.abstract: A self-supervised multimodal model recovers galaxy stellar masses from sparse JWST data that lack the multi-band coverage required by traditional SED fitting. We train on single-band F150W imaging paired with observed-frame 1-2 $μ$m PRISM spectra and obtain a joint image-spectrum representation that recovers stellar mass at $1<z\le3$ with $R^2 \sim 0.9$ and $σ_{\mathrm{NMAD}} = 0.24$ dex; cross-modal CLIP alignment further raises single-modality performance by $ΔR^2 = +0.04$ (imaging) and $+0.09$ (spectroscopy), narrowing the gap to joint-modality inference. The code and documentation are available at \href{https://github.com/2003cy/neurips2026_ssl_jwst}{GitHub}.

entries.title: A cosmic filament catalog for COSMOS-Web Data Release 1 across 0.5 < z < 3.5
entries.abstract: Cosmic filaments represent the environments in which most galaxies form and evolve. However, the spatial distribution of filaments and the link between galaxy properties and their positions relative to filaments remains unclear, particularly at high redshifts. In this work, using the deep-field catalog COSMOS-Web Data Release 1, we construct a filament catalog spanning 0.5 < z < 3.5 that can be directly applied to studies of galaxy evolution and the galaxy--large-scale-structure connection at the peak epoch of galaxy and black hole formation. We developed a new procedure based on the DisPerSE method that fully incorporates the probability distribution functions (PDFs) of galaxy photometric redshifts by generating multiple realizations for each tomographic 2D slice. We then stacked these realizations to construct ``filament probability maps'' (w_ fil maps), from which filaments were subsequently extracted. The filament extraction parameters were optimized using mock catalogs generated from TNG simulations by minimizing the discrepancies between 3D and projected 2D filaments. Applying this procedure to the COSMOS-Web data, we detected 12,523 filaments (comprising 136,210 segments) across 0.5 < z < 3.5 and released a filament catalog, a companion segment catalog, and filament probability maps for each slice. Validation against astrophysical properties shows a strong agreement between the extracted filaments and those in the simulations, supporting the robustness of the filament extraction. These data products provide a robust foundation for investigating galaxy--environment coevolution at cosmic noon and beyond.

entries.title: The XMM-Newton view of the DEM L36 superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud
entries.abstract: We present the first multi-wavelength analysis of the DEM L36 superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud. We compare the DEM L36 superbubble with other Galactic and Magellanic Cloud superbubbles. We use data from XMM-Newton, supplemented by data from the Magellanic Cloud Emission Line Survey, the Dark Energy Camera Magellanic Cloud Emission Line Survey, the Spitzer Space Telescope, and the Australia Telescope Compact Array. We perform a multi-wavelength morphological analysis to understand the shape and structure of the superbubble and X-ray spectral analysis to derive physical parameters of the hot gas. We find significant X-ray emission in DEM L36, dominated by a central bubble region mostly confined by a thin H$α$ filamentary shell. This has two distinct blowout regions to the east and west, with a possible smaller blowout in the south. Spectral analysis shows the X-ray emission is well fit with a thermal plasma model in collisional ionisation equilibrium with a temperature of $kT=0.17~(0.16-0.18)$ keV and unabsorbed luminosity $L_{X~(0.5-7.0~\mathrm{keV})}=3.62\times 10^{35} $erg s$^{-1}$. Unlike other LMC superbubbles, we find no clear powering cluster at the centre, though relatively small clusters near the edge are likely supplying the mechanical input at the present epoch. We use photometric data of these clusters to estimate cluster masses, ages, and mechanical inputs to compare with the energy stored in the superbubble. We find that these clusters have supplied more energy over their lifetime than is currently observed in the superbubble, indicative of the so-called growth rate discrepancy problem. It is likely the DEM L36 superbubble was initially shaped by a central massive stellar population that has since dispersed and largely lost to supernovae, with smaller clusters at the edges of the swept-up shell being currently supplying the energy input.

entries.title: Eight new, triply eclipsing triple star systems
entries.abstract: We have identified numerous triply eclipsing hierarchical triple star systems from observations made with the space telescope TESS. For many of these systems we can potentially determine their dynamical and astrophysical parameters with high precision, in some cases even without the use of radial velocity data. In the present paper we report the comprehensive study of eight new, triply eclipsing triple star systems, taken from this larger sample: TICs 77177148, 220456364, 232874003, 306690194, 343763382, 358795247, 379084660, 385933895. Besides the photometric data from the TESS observations, we obtained supplementary ground-based photometric measurements, as well as radial velocity measurements for some of the systems. The eclipse timing variation curves extracted from the TESS data and from the ground-based follow up data, the photometric light curves, radial velocity data, and the spectral energy distribution are combined in a complex photodynamical analysis to yield the stellar and orbital parameters for all of the investigated systems. The outer periods are in the range of 63-294 days, including the currently sixth tightest known triple system, TI 385933895 with an outer to inner period ratio of 9.82. We find that all of the triples are nearly coplanar, with mutual inclination angles of <=2.5deg. Despite such flatness, we still detect eclipse depth variations in TIC 220456364 that are induced by orbital plane precession. Moreover, we find that TIC 358795247 is likely a (2+1)+1-type hierarchical quadruple system. Finally we make some statistical assessments of a number of the orbital elements, stellar parameters, and distances of these systems.

entries.title: In Search of the Gravitational Wave of Fast X-Ray Transient in the Second Part of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Fourth Observing Run
entries.abstract: Fast X-ray Transients (FXTs) are brief, intense X-ray flashes unassociated with persistent X-ray sources or known stellar objects, typically lasting from seconds to hours. With the launch of the Einstein Probe in January 2024, the study of FXTs has entered a new phase. Its large field of view significantly increases the discovery rate, enabling more robust statistics. The leading discoveries have revealed a fraction of gamma-ray bursts, while the rest remain unexplained. We propose a methodology to search for possible relations between gravitational waves (GWs) and FXTs, as it may serve as a discrepancy among proposed theoretical models. To achieve this, we intend to utilize X-Pipeline, an unmodeled search algorithm, to identify excess coherent signals in LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) O4b observations. Out of 64 FXTs events, we obtained 19 FXTs for constructing robust searches. Given the absence of any detectable GW signals, we subsequently calculated upper limits and estimated exclusion distances for each source. In order to enrich the sample base and statistical analysis, this methodology could henceforth be conducted through future GW searches, including KAGRA in the O4c and O5 observations.

entries.title: Analysis of a coronal hole jet in the chromosphere and the transition region with IRIS data and SDO observations
entries.abstract: Coronal jets are transient phenomena that occur throughout the solar atmosphere, often triggered by the activation of mini-filaments. Jets are an important field of study, as they are believed to contribute to the mass supply of the solar wind. We study a small-scale solar jet occurring in a low-latitude coronal hole, focusing on traces of the jet eruption to the lower atmosphere, utilizing chromospheric and transition region diagnostics. We also investigate the possible mechanisms and dynamic conditions leading to its onset. We analyze ultraviolet spectra from the Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph to investigate chromospheric dynamics and their connection to the transition region, using diagnostics of the Mg II k 2796.35 Å and Si IV 1393.75 Å lines, together with non-LTE inversions. We complement this analysis with multiwavelength imaging and magnetograms from the Solar Dynamics Observatory, as well as magnetic field modeling. The analysis of Mg II k and Si IV parameters reveals a coupling between chromospheric and transition region plasma dynamics. Profiles on the jet spire present deeper central reversals, larger peak separations and higher transition region Doppler velocities. The jet initiation is associated with a mini-filament-like structure, preceded by dynamic variations in the photospheric magnetic field. We find single-peaked Mg II k profiles at one of its footpoints, possibly indicating plasma drainage. The presence of a null point and a quasi-separatrix layer suggests that reconnection can play a role in the mini-filament-like structure destabilization and jet eruption. This study suggests that the signature and possibly the origin of coronal jets can be traced down to the chromosphere. The detailed analysis of the Mg II k profiles at the jet spire and the mini-filament-like structure may provide valuable observational constraints for future MHD simulations.

entries.title: Breaking the symmetry: X-ray polarization from a spreading layer on a tilted weakly magnetized neutron star
entries.abstract: When modeling the emission from an X-ray binary system, we often assume that the rotational axis of the compact object is aligned with that of the binary system. While often considered irrelevant for spectroscopic observations, the orientation of the binary system is crucial for polarimetric properties. With the recent advent of X-ray polarimetric observations enabled by the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE), indications of a possible misalignment of the neutron star rotational axis with respect to the binary axis have been reported. Following these indications, we present an analytical model for the polarimetric properties of emission arising from a spreading layer on an inclined weakly magnetized neutron star (WMNS). We discuss the expected polarimetric properties and study the impact of geometrical parameters of the system on the polarization of WMNS emission. We compare our results with those for aligned systems. Finally, we discuss applications of the model to recent and upcoming X-ray polarimetric observations with IXPE and mention the suggestions for further development of the model.

entries.title: Multigroup Radiation Diffusion with Compton Scattering on a Moving Mesh: Implementation in RICH and Application to Tidal Disruption Events
entries.abstract: Compton scattering exchanges energy between radiation and hot gas and changes the spectrum in high-energy astrophysical systems such as tidal disruption events (TDEs). Because it couples all photon energies and can act faster than the hydrodynamic time step, many radiation-hydrodynamics (RHD) simulations omit its spectral redistribution or treat its energy exchange in the gray approximation. We extend the multigroup flux-limited diffusion module of the moving-mesh RHD code RICH to include Compton scattering with the exact thermal Compton kernel. In our semi-implicit scheme for the thermal radiative transfer equation, the temperature dependence of the kernel enters a generalized Fleck factor, and the group Compton operator conserves photon number and satisfies detailed balance. In equilibration tests, the scheme agrees with independent solutions, relaxes without absorption and emission to a Bose-Einstein spectrum, and remains stable for time steps that do not resolve the Compton equilibration timescale. We apply it to a three-dimensional simulation of the disruption of a $0.5\,M_\odot$ star by a $10^6\,M_\odot$ black hole. We find that during the X-ray flash, inverse Compton scattering dominates the coupling between the gas and the radiation near the nozzle shock, where it adds X-ray energy much faster than thermal emission and may affect the dynamics. Outside the X-ray thermalization radii, its instantaneous X-ray production rate during the flash is comparable to or larger than the escaping X-ray luminosity, so it may contribute substantially to the X-ray emission from TDEs.

entries.title: Spectral Properties of X-Ray Flares in Gamma-Ray Bursts
entries.abstract: We conducted a systematic spectral analysis of the X-ray flares of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) observed by Swift/X-ray Telescope from 2005 April to 2015 March. The sample includes 521 flares from 206 GRBs. The GRBs cover the three subtypes: X-ray flashes (XRFs), X-ray-rich GRBs (XRRs), and classical GRBs (C-GRBs). We used a simple power-law model to fit the spectra during the flares, as well as to fit the preflare and postflare afterglow emissions, and obtained the parameters such as photon index and intrinsic hydrogen column density ($N_{\rm H}$). By comparing the spectral characteristics of flares, prompt emission, and afterglow emission, and analyzing the temporal evolution of the X-ray flare spectra, we obtained the following main conclusions. (1) The spectrum during the flare phase is significantly harder than that of the preflare and postflare phases, while there is no obvious difference in the spectrum between the preflare and postflare phases. (2) The intrinsic $N_{\rm H}$ shows no significant change between the preflare and flare phases, but significantly decreases after the flare. (3) The overall X-ray flare spectra are softer than those of the prompt emission. (4) For GRBs with multiple flares, the photon index softens with increasing flare peak time. (5) The X-ray flare spectra in XRFs are softer than those in C-GRBs. These results support the origin of X-ray flares being from the internal shock radiation driven by the late activity of the GRB central engine.

entries.title: FRB 20210601A: Extreme Temporal Clustering in a Repeating Fast Radio Burst Source as Evidence for a Hidden Class of Episodic Repeaters
entries.abstract: Population studies of fast radio burst (FRB) repetition typically model sources using a single distribution of steady, time-averaged burst rates, yet individual sources show significant departures from this assumption. Here we present FRB 20210601A, a source discovered by the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment FRB project (CHIME/FRB) that represents the most extreme such departure yet identified. The source produced at least nine bursts within a single 106.5 s interval -- the highest instantaneous burst rate yet reported from a repeating FRB source at $\gtrsim 2$ Jy ms fluences -- yet remained otherwise undetected despite $\sim 320$ hr of exposure spanning 7 yr. The active interval occurred while the source was in a side-lobe of the CHIME/FRB digitized beams, implying an instantaneous burst rate $\gtrsim2.3\times$ higher ($\gtrsim$ 21 bursts) at main-lobe sensitivity. The source's intense, brief burst storm flanked by apparent quiescence despite substantial exposure is unique among the CHIME/FRB repeater sample, although its burst morphology, excess dispersion measure ($\rm{DM_{excess}} \sim 360$ pc cm$^{-3}$), Faraday rotation measure ($|\rm{RM_{excess}}| \sim 150-170$ rad m$^{-2}$), and temporal scattering ($τ\lesssim 0.37$ ms at 600 MHz) are otherwise typical. Modeling a population of episodically active repeaters (i.e., short burst storms separated by long recurrence times) and accounting for declination-dependent exposure, we forecast $\sim1-4$ additional source discoveries similar to FRB 20210601A over the next decade of CHIME/FRB operations, corresponding to a CHIME/FRB-detectable population of $9^{+200}_{-8}$ sources (68% credible interval). These results demonstrate that highly episodic repeaters could constitute a selection-biased but detectable component of the FRB population, possibly reflecting distinct magnetospheric states or triggering mechanisms.

entries.title: Synthetic 2D magnetic turbulence with controlled island structuring
entries.abstract: Magnetic turbulence remains up to this day not fully understood, despite its important role in the behavior of plasmas. A recurring ingredient in plasma turbulence is the spontaneous formation and evolution of plasmoids. These represent magnetic islands on current sheets in two-dimensional turbulent magnetic fields that are consistently found in high-resolution direct numerical simulations (DNSs) using a magnetohydrodynamic description. However, such simulations require considerable amounts of computational power. Synthetic turbulence models provide an alternative, cheap approach to the generation of fully-developed turbulent fields. In this work, we first present an extension of our open-source, general synthetic turbulence BxC toolkit that is specifically tailored to generate 2D turbulent magnetic fields. We then use a novel physically motivated, but purely geometric construction that generates current sheet island chains, which results in fields that visually match the ones obtained through DNSs. We show how this construction affects the magnetic field lines and find a correlation with the formation of magnetic O-points and X-points. The magnetic flux and size of the islands in the field are found to match well with theoretical scaling laws. Lastly, we show BxC's capabilities by generating a 2D $N\times N$ turbulent magnetic field of resolution $N = 100000$, going beyond the state-of-the-art reached by simulations, on a single CPU with modest computational resources. Our construction maintains direct control over the inertial range, and allows to make morphological changes to the plasmoids and fields, demonstrating plasmoid appearance, disappearance and merging.

entries.title: A Catalog of Spectral Properties for DESI DR1 Quasars
entries.abstract: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) is carrying out a five-year spectroscopic survey designed to map the large-scale structure of the Universe and obtain spectra for millions of galaxies and quasars over a wide redshift range. We present a value-added catalog of spectral properties for 1,717,774 unique quasars (1,774,723 spectra) in the DESI Data Release 1. We perform a uniform spectral decomposition of the quasar continuum, host galaxy emission (at $z<1$), and \FeII\ emission, and measure the line properties of major broad and narrow emission lines from Ly$α$ to H$α$ covered by DESI spectra. We also provide single-epoch black hole mass estimates (from H$β$, \MgII, and \CIV), bolometric luminosities, and Eddington ratios for these quasars. We provide systemic redshifts that account for the intrinsic velocity shifts of individual lines; they agree with the DESI pipeline redshifts to within 500~km s$^{-1}$ for 88.6\% of the sample, and are most useful at $z>1$ where the pipeline redshift is heavily constrained by blueshifted high-ionization lines. We also provide local fits to several optical coronal lines, including \NeV~$\lambda3426$, [\ion{Fe}{7}]~$\lambda5722$, [\ion{Fe}{7}]~$\lambda6088$, and [\ion{Fe}{11}]~$\lambda7893$. We show that several emission-line ratios, including those involving coronal lines, vary systematically with Eddington ratio. The catalog is intended as a community resource for studies of quasar demographics, black hole accretion, emission-line physics, and the connection between the broad-, coronal-, and narrow-line regions.

entries.title: Gravitational Wave Diffractive Images Reveal the Structure of Astrophysical Objects
entries.abstract: Scattering patterns encode the structure of extended objects, as demonstrated by charged particle scattering on atomic nuclei. Gravitational wave (GW) diffraction offers an analogous probe of otherwise invisible mass distributions. At linear order in the lens potential we derive expressions relating the central diffractive image contribution to a gravitationally lensed GW waveform to the Fourier transform of the projected lens density. For finite mass lenses this contribution takes the form of a point mass Born amplitude multiplied by a normalized mass form factor, analogous to that in nuclear scattering. As the frequency of GWs from a merging compact binary source evolves the signal samples this form factor across spatial scales, imprinting lens structure through interference with the primary image. Using full numerical wave optics calculations we quantify the observational reach for extended dark matter objects, primordial black holes halo-dressed by dark matter halos and superradiance clouds of ultralight bosons around black holes. For the considered source populations, five year observations with next generation detectors can distinguish extended lenses from point masses, probing dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-5})$, and halo-dressed primordial black holes from matched bare black holes, probing primordial black hole dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-6})$. For sufficiently close source-lens configurations, scalar superradiance clouds can produce distinguishable diffraction signatures for boson masses of approximately $10^{-17}-10^{-12}~\mathrm{eV}$. These results provide a framework for characterizing extended dark matter and compact object astrophysical environments.

entries.title: Simulation-based inference of profile evolution for high-precision pulsar timing
entries.abstract: Pulsars are exceptional cosmic laboratories, the most stable of which rival atomic clocks. Nearly all of that precision rests on one observable, the average pulse profile unique to each pulsar and stable over decades. These profiles change shape systematically with observing frequency, reflecting the physics of the emitting pulsar beam, but if left unmodelled, it can bias the arrival-time measurements, undermining precision timing. Profile-domain timing has been proposed to address this effect, but current implementations use stochastic sampling, which is computationally prohibitive and has limited the application in large-scale analyses. Here, we present a simulation-based inference approach to profile-domain timing, using a normalising flow conditioned on a convolutional embedding of the frequency-phase portrait. From a single portrait, it returns joint posteriors on dispersion measures, arrival times, and the parameters governing profile evolution instantaneously, with uncertainties verified against known inputs following an initial training run. The value of a likelihood-free approach is that the simulator becomes the interface to pulsar properties. Fundamental properties like non-Gaussian noise, pulsar self-noise, jitter, scattering, and profile change can be inferred by simulating them rather than by deriving a new likelihood for each, opening a promising pathway to include machine learning methods into pulsar timing workflows.

entries.title: Unexpected Local Enhancement of Chromospheric Moreton Waves on the Sun
entries.abstract: Solar eruptions often drive shock waves. When propagating in the solar corona, strong shock waves would leave imprints on the solar surface in the chromosphere, which are called Moreton waves. Moreton waves generally decay as they move away. However, to our knowledge, for the first time we report that a Moreton wave is significantly enhanced midway during propagation, as revealed by the spectroscopic observations from China's first solar satellite, the Chinese H$α$ Solar Explorer. Combining magnetic measurements from the Solar Dynamics Observatory, we found that the location of the Moreton wave enhancement corresponds to a magnetic null point at an altitude of $\sim$70 Mm in the corona. It is demonstrated that the unexpected local enhancement of the Moreton wave is due to mode conversion around the magnetic null point, i.e., fast-mode waves are converted to slow-mode waves which are trapped locally. It is further revealed that, even for ordinary Moreton wave fronts, the H$α$ Doppler redshift velocity is positively correlated with the height of widespread low-altitude magnetic null points, implying that these low-lying null points, $\sim$1--7 Mm above the solar surface, facilitate mode conversion with different efficiency, thereby accounting for the spatially inhomogeneous Dopplergram of Moreton wave fronts.

entries.title: Slow Massive-Star Formation and the O-Star ZAMS Deficit
entries.abstract: The scarcity of optically visible O stars near the theoretical zero-age main sequence (ZAMS) has puzzled astronomers for over four decades. We argue that it reflects prolonged accretion. If massive stars assemble over Myr timescales, as the inertial-inflow model predicts, core-hydrogen burning begins before accretion ends, and the stars become optically visible at the end of accretion on a birthline displaced from the standard ZAMS. We test this interpretation by comparing the hot-side envelope of Galactic O stars in the Kiel diagram with accreting stellar-evolution models, adopting a growth law $t_{\mathrm{form}}=τ_0(m_{\mathrm{f}}/60 M_\odot)^α$ with formation time $t_{\mathrm{form}}$ and final mass $m_{\mathrm{f}}$. The resulting birthlines reproduce both the displacement and the high-mass turnover of the observed envelope, with best-fitting parameters $(α,τ_0)=(0.52,4.3\,\mathrm{Myr})$, consistent with independent constraints from the luminosity functions of compact H II regions and OB stars. The two constraints have orthogonal degeneracy directions, so combining them narrows the allowed parameter space, yielding projected 90% confidence intervals $0.43<α<0.60$ and $3.9<τ_0/\mathrm{Myr}<5.0$. The inferred growth law agrees with cloud-scale simulations and the inertial-inflow model, and implies that mass assembly and main-sequence evolution overlap substantially in massive stars, with broader implications for stellar evolution and feedback.

entries.title: Prompt Jet Launching and Delayed Thermal Disk in Tidal Disruption Event for Prolonged Activity GRB 220706A
entries.abstract: GRB 220706A exhibits X-ray flaring activity extending to ~51 days after the trigger, along with a luminous optical thermal component emerging on a timescale of ~10^6 s. Such prolonged central-engine activity could be powered by a collapsar fed by an extended stellar envelope. However, a relativistic jet may struggle to break out of the extended envelope. These challenges motivate a tidal disruption event (TDE), although explaining both the early relativistic jet and the luminous late optical thermal emission within one TDE framework remains difficult. We investigate a TDE scenario in which shocks between stellar debris streams drive the early inflow of some debris, potentially carrying preexisting fossil magnetic flux toward the black hole (BH) and powering an initial relativistic jet via the Blandford-Znajek mechanism. The remaining debris circularizes into an accretion disk, whose thermal emission accounts for the late optical thermal component. For GRB 220706A, the optical timescale, luminosity, and color temperature are consistent with disruption of a blue supergiant (M_*~50M_{sun}, R_*~20~R_{sun}) by a BH of mass M_{BH}~10^5 M_{sun}, assuming that the accretion disk forms on a timescale comparable to the orbital period of the most tightly bound stellar debris. A magnetic field strength of ~10^5 G is required near the BH before disruption to power a jet capable of producing the inferred gamma-ray luminosity. Continued fallback may sustain central-engine activity beyond the observed X-ray flaring episode, making future X-ray monitoring a test of this scenario.

entries.title: SpecLess: A Multi Survey Python Package for Machine Learning Classification of Galaxy Morphology and Activity from Photometry
entries.abstract: Broad band photometry enables scalable galaxy classification without spectroscopy at inference time, yet strong within survey performance may not transfer when the same galaxies are measured by another survey. We present SpecLess, an open source Python package implementing two photometric classification tasks: high confidence Galaxy Zoo 1 elliptical and spiral morphologies, and four SDSS spectroscopic activity reference classes (starforming, starburst, Seyfert, and LINER). Using SDSS+AllWISE, KiDS+VIKING, and DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys photometry, survey specific XGBoost classifiers achieve held out macro F1 scores of 0.9332 (SDSS; 35,554 galaxies) and 0.9237 (KiDS; 3,269) for morphology, and 0.7637 (SDSS; 16,931) and 0.7398 (DESI; 11,975) for activity. Starforming and starburst references are recovered more effectively than Seyfert and LINER, while feature ablations reveal complementary contributions from optical and mid infrared photometry. We quantify catalogue dependence using separately trained common feature models evaluated on matched galaxies with identical labels and data partitions. Relative to target trained models, macro F1 deficits are 0.0153 (SDSS to KiDS) and 0.0354 (KiDS to SDSS) for morphology (12,301 galaxies; 20 splits), and 0.0660 (SDSS to DESI) and 0.0406 (DESI to SDSS) for activity (11,975 test galaxies). Colour only refits, additive corrections, and optical infrared substitutions reveal direction dependent sensitivity without consistently recovering target trained performance. SpecLess v0.3.0 distributes four pretrained, survey specific classifiers through a unified Python interface. The package provides a reproducible baseline for photometric galaxy classification across multiple surveys while establishing an extensible, open source foundation for future developments in classification methods and photometric catalogue support.

entries.title: A Generalized Framework for Rapid Polarization Response Generation in Wide Field-of-View Compton Polarimeters
entries.abstract: Polarimetry is the most direct probe of the unsettled radiation mechanism and magnetic field structure of gamma-ray burst (GRB) prompt emission at the energies where it peaks, tens of keV to about 1 MeV. Compton polarimeters use the azimuthal scattering angle distribution (ASAD), a 180 degree modulation on axis. GRB measurements have largely relied on the on-axis modulation factor $μ_{100}$. For a wide field-of-view planar polarimeter, GRBs arrive off axis, where the Klein-Nishina projection adds harmonics to the ASAD. Muleri (2014) described this projection and evaluated it in a low-energy expansion for X-rays. We evaluate it numerically without approximation over the whole prompt-emission energy band for any incidence and polarization angles, quantify the off-axis harmonics a single modulation factor cannot capture, and verify the model against GEANT4 simulations of an ideal polarimeter. We also include the effect of the detection threshold on the ASAD. With POLAR as the case study, we present two modes that build the full polarization response with at least 95 percent fewer Monte Carlo simulations. Mode 1 takes only the unpolarized simulation per energy and recovers the polarization measured with POLAR's full GEANT4 responses for all but the brightest GRBs, where it underestimates the polarization degree. Mode 2 adds two polarized simulations per energy at distinct angles and reproduces the simulated ASADs to their statistical noise and the polarization of every GRB tested. Both modes are released as open-source software for any planar Compton polarimeter.

entries.title: Granulation-driven spectral irradiance variability of Sun-like stars
entries.abstract: Granulation,caused by convection in low-mass stars like the Sun, introduces small amplitude variations in the stellar brightness on timescales of minutes to hours. Often referred to as flicker or microvariability this signal can impede detecting Earth-sized planets around Sun-like stars via stellar transits. Stellar flicker can also introduce uncertainties in determining stellar fundamental parameters and cause errors of up to 10% in the radius determination of transiting exoplanets. Both sources of uncertainties will propagate into planetary transmission spectra and resulting atmospheric retrievals. We present a method for modelling stellar flicker that enables scaling the flicker of Sun-like stars between different wavelengths and passbands to facilitate better solar-stellar comparisons. We use the 3D radiative magnetohydrodynamic code MURaM to simulate the granulation pattern on a Sun-like star and employ the radiative transfer code MPS-ATLAS for the spectral synthesis of the MURaM output, producing lightcurves of the granulation signal in various wavelengths and at different disc positions. Using these synthetic lightcurves, we establish scaling relations in the time and frequency domain between different wavelengths and passbands routinely used in stellar observations, such as the Kepler and TESS space telescopes. We find that the variability caused by granulation is very well correlated across wavelengths from 300 to 6000 nm, enabling scalings from one wavelength regime to another. We present the scaling sensitivities in different passbands and wavelength regimes that can be used to facilitate solar-stellar comparisons and help estimate stellar flicker in observations using photometric passbands and low-resolution transmission spectra.

entries.title: Charged fluid tori with an approximate magnetic self-field around magnetized Schwarzschild black holes: A semi-analytic approach
entries.abstract: We study toroidal structures formed by a charged, non-self-gravitating perfect fluid orbiting a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in a poloidal magnetic field. To obtain analytic and semi-analytic solutions, we assume a cold, rest-mass-dominated fluid with uniform specific charge and zero conductivity, so the current is purely convective. This regime is formally opposite to the ideal GRMHD limit. The total magnetic field comprises a prescribed asymptotically uniform external component and an approximate self-field associated with the azimuthal current in the torus. We represent the latter by a regularized dipole approximation to the field of an effective circular current loop. Neglecting the self-field, the method of characteristics yields a general implicit solution of the integrability condition for a function parametrizing the specific-angular-momentum profile. A separately obtained cylindrically dependent class recovers a solution from our earlier work. For the radially dependent class, we integrate the Euler equations, obtain the enthalpy potential, and derive local conditions for equatorially centered tori. We then examine the field-free limit, both magnetic components separately, and their superposition. The external field supports closed tori within analytically derived parameter bounds, whereas no such equilibrium is found for the isolated approximate self-field within the numerically explored domain. In a representative combined-field sequence, the radial extent varies nonmonotonically with relative self-field strength: it increases for weak self-fields and decreases as the self-field becomes comparable to the external field. The results show how an approximate magnetic self-field modifies the morphology and domain of existence of charged-fluid tori.

entries.title: Some minimal characteristics and flat trajectories of a system in the N-body problem
entries.abstract: For the classical model of a system of N particles with interaction (the N-body problem) we consider some spatial problems of nonlinear programming for finding conditional minima and local extrema for the main characteristics of the system on its phase space. We prove that these conditional minima and local extrema of the system characteristics can only be achieved on flat, in general, not necessarily finite, trajectories of the system in space, (under the condition that the system angular momentum is non-zero). And then we find the basic conditions limiting the values of the integrals of motion: angular momentum and total energy of the system under which these trajectories are flat finite ("circular" or elliptical) trajectories on which the flat structure of the system is preserved in time under the certain restrictions on the values of the system's integrals of motion. And we determine also the values of the system's key characteristics on these flat trajectories. Next, in the Appendix, we consider some additional related results for a more general model of the system.

entries.title: Formation and Detectability of PSR J0653+0443-like Extremely Eccentric Binary Neutron Stars in the Milky Way
entries.abstract: Recently, the Five-hundred-meter-Aperture-Spherical-radio-Telescope (FAST) Galactic Plane Pulsar Snapshot (GPPS) survey discovers an extraordinary binary neutron star (BNS) system, PSR J0653+0443, possessing the highest known orbital eccentricity ($e\approx0.992$) among Galactic BNSs (Yang et al., 2026), which provides a unique probe into the formation and evolution of BNSs. In this Letter, we perform compact binary population synthesis calculations with self-consistent neutron star spin evolution to model extremely eccentric BNS population detectable by the FAST GPPS survey, explicitly incorporating observational selection effects. We find that BNSs with $e>0.99$ constitute only $\sim0.6\%$ of the detectable population, with an expected detection number of $λ_{\mathrm{GPPS}}\approx0.31$ over the full planned footprint. Thus, although rare, systems as eccentric as PSR J0653+0443 are compatible with standard binary evolution. We further demonstrate that extremely eccentric BNSs arise preferentially from core-collapse supernovae, whereas imposing $P\lesssim0.1$ s select older, more frequently recycled systems, which naturally reproduce the observed properties of PSR J0653+0443. We further predict that the completed GPPS sample has a $\sim15\%$ chance of finding another $e>0.99$ BNS, but a much higher $\sim88\%$ chance for $e>0.90$ systems. By contrast, future facilities are expected to enlarge the detectable highly eccentric BNS population, with SKA potentially detecting PSR J0653+0443-like systems and sub-mHz gravitational-wave detectors probing a larger population with $e>0.9$, enabling much more in-depth population-level constraints.

entries.title: A Robust Estimator for the Lyman-$α$ Forest 1D Power Spectrum at High Redshift
entries.abstract: The Lyman-$α$ (Ly$α$) forest flux power spectrum $P(k)$ is sensitive to a range of astrophysical and cosmological effects, including the thermal state of and large-scale fluctuations in the intergalactic medium and the nature of dark matter. Measuring $P(k)$ becomes increasingly challenging at high redshift, where fewer quasar spectra are available and higher Ly$α$ optical depths result in lower transmitted flux. In addition, observational effects and missing data complicate standard Fourier-transform estimators. Here, we validate a likelihood-based estimator for $P(k)$. The method constructs the pixel-level covariance matrix of the transmitted flux field using precomputed $k$-space integrals that account for instrumental resolution and pixelization, enabling direct maximum-likelihood inference of $P(k)$. We test the estimator using mock Ly$α$ forest spectra at $z \geq 5$, including analytic Gaussian realizations generated from known power spectra and forward-modeled simulation spectra incorporating observational effects relevant to high-redshift quasar surveys, such as finite spectral resolution, pixel sampling, noise, and missing data. We compare the recovered power spectra with both the input spectra and standard Fourier-transform estimates. We find that the likelihood-based estimator recovers the input power spectrum across the tested scales well within expected error and remains robust to the observational effects considered. This work establishes a framework for measuring Ly$α$ forest clustering with a robust, nearly optimal power spectrum estimator, with particular focus on quantifying large-scale fluctuations that may arise from ultraviolet background fluctuations or the late stages of reionization.

entries.title: Magnetic Activity as a Driver of Low-gravity-like Spectral Morphology in Late-M Dwarfs
entries.abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the connection between magnetic activity and the low-surface-gravity-like near-infrared spectral morphology of late-M dwarfs. Our sample includes TRAPPIST-1 observed with JWST NIRISS/SOSS and 22 late-M dwarfs observed with IRTF/SpeX, together with flare observations from K2, TESS, JWST NIRISS/SOSS, and literature-reported X-ray luminosities. Using one-component PHOENIX/NewEra spectral modeling, we find that all targets are better reproduced by lower-surface-gravity model spectra than by models with the expected high gravities of field late-M dwarfs. The retrieved surface gravities moderately correlate with independently measured gravity-sensitive spectral indices, with the strongest trends seen for FeH$_z$ at 0.998~$μ$m and FeH$_J$ at 1.2~$μ$m, both showing statistically significant Pearson and Spearman correlations with $p<0.005$. They also show strong anti-correlations with flare luminosity and X-ray luminosity: for both relations, Pearson and Spearman coefficients are $<-0.9$, with $p \leq 1.0\times10^{-4}$, indicating that more active stars tend to have spectra favoring lower-gravity morphologies. Time-series spectra of TRAPPIST-1 during two large flares show no clear short-timescale variations in selected photospheric indices, suggesting that persistent small-scale magnetic activity may play a more important role than large flares in modifying the photospheric temperature--pressure structure. A simplified radiative-transfer experiment further shows that activity-associated heating can produce lower-gravity-like spectral features even when the input surface gravity is fixed. Our results suggest that underestimated surface gravities in late-M dwarfs may reflect atmospheres modified by frequent, small-scale magnetic activity, such as microflares, producing emergent spectra that mimic lower-gravity morphology.

entries.title: Odd radio circle J1555+2726: Observational evidence for shock re-acceleration of fossil plasma
entries.abstract: Context. Odd radio circles (ORCs) are peculiar extragalactic sources recently discovered. They are characterised by one or more bright rings extending on scales of hundreds of kiloparsecs, and are filled with fainter emission. A massive elliptical galaxy lies at the centre of ORCs. While their formation mechanism is debated, a shock is plausibly involved. Aims. We aim to constrain the nature of ORC J1555+2726 (ORC4) through the analysis of its morphological and spectral properties. Methods. We utilised Low Frequency ARray (LOFAR), upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (uGMRT), and MeerKAT radio data at 50-1284 MHz to obtain images and spectral index maps at high resolution and sensitivity. Results. Both the resolution and observing frequency affect the observed morphology. In particular, the brightness contrast between the ring and the filling emission becomes progressively smoother from higher to lower frequencies. We measured an integrated spectrum of slope $α=1.06\pm 0.03$, a radio power of $P_{\rm 150}= (5.4\pm 0.5)\times 10^{25} \; {\rm W \; Hz^{-1}}$ at 150 MHz, and a radial spectral flattening down to $α\sim0.5$ at the ring location. However, we inferred a negative (convex) spectral curvature and a peculiar spectral shape in radio colour-colour diagrams, which imply spectral flattening towards high frequencies. These properties cannot be explained by shock acceleration of thermal particles and standard ageing. Conclusions. The observed features suggest that a mixture of electrons with different spectra coexist within ORC4 volume, likely associated with shock re-acceleration of a fossil relativistic reservoir. The ring emission is plausibly dominated by higher-energy electrons re-accelerated at the shock front, while lower-energy re-accelerated electrons are more uniformly distributed across the whole source (possibly ellipsoidal) volume.

entries.title: Boosted Dark Matter Directionality in Large Liquid Scintillator Detectors
entries.abstract: Light dark matter can be boosted by cosmic-ray-dark matter interactions, which opens the possibility of direct-detection searches with large neutrino detectors. We consider the signal produced by boosted dark matter undergoing quasi-elastic scattering off carbon and knocking out a neutron in a large liquid scintillator detector. A distinctive delayed gamma ray from neutron capture can be reconstructed after $\sim 210$ $μ$s, which is paired up with the prompt signal during neutron propagation. We find that 100 kt$\cdot$yr of data from the neutron-coincidence channel will be able to probe new parameter space compared to free proton signals found in previous work. We further consider the possibility of utilizing directional information from the displaced vertex associated with the capture of the final-state neutron. However, we find that directional information does not materially improve the sensitivity due to the large nucleon scattering angle.

analysis.title_zh: 强子-夸克物质的通用物态方程：首次应用于中子星吸积致相变模拟
analysis.reason: 文章构建了包含夸克相中微子不透明度的通用强子-夸克混合状态方程族，并采用全广义相对论辐射流体动力学首次研究吸积致强子-夸克一阶相变；否定了此前弱相变抛射可观测暂现源抛射物的结论，给出了相变伴随的中微子光度演化与核致密化特征，对超新星中心引擎及致密天体高能暂现源具有重要参考价值。
analysis.problem: 双星长期吸积使得中子星越过强子分支边缘诱发相变时，相变动力学过程是否能抛射物质产生电磁暂现源，以及夸克相中微子发射与弱相互作用平衡对中子星演化有何定量影响。

analysis.title_zh: 来自过去的γ幽灵：超新星成因的类轴子粒子再加热中子星
analysis.reason: 文章研究核心坍缩超新星（CCSN）原中子星中产生的类轴子粒子（ALP）被引力束缚后通过 $a \to \gamma\gamma$ 衰变持续再加热致密中子星残骸的机制，利用已知最冷中子星及年轻中子星（如 Cas A）的热辐射观测，对 MeV 能段 ALP 与光子的耦合常数给出了极具竞争力的排斥线，属于致密天体高能物理与超新星遗迹中心引擎的交叉理论限制。
analysis.result: 超新星内部通过核子-核子轫致辐射（及 $\pi^-$ 转换）产生的非相对论性 ALP 会被束缚在原中子星引力势阱中形成扩展约 $100\,{\rm km}$ 的粒子云，随后以寿命 $\tau_a^{-1} = g_{a\gamma\gamma}^2 m_a^3 / (64\pi)$ 衰变释放光子加热中子星。基于冷中子星 PSR J2144$-$3933 的 HST 测光上限 $T_{\rm NS} \leq 3.4 \times 10^4\,{\rm K}$（对应 $L_{\rm NS} \leq 1.4 \times 10^{27}\,{\rm erg\,s^{-1}}$），在固定核子耦合 $g_{ap} = 2.7 \times 10^{-10}\,{\rm GeV}^{-1}$ 下排除了 $1-400\,{\rm MeV}$ 质量区间内大量未探测参数空间，灵敏度下限遵循标度关系 $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto m_a^{5/2}$，而衰变耗尽截断（天花板）遵循 $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto m_a^{-3/2}$。年轻中子星 Cas A（年龄约 $330\,{\rm yr}$）可封堵更强耦合天花板；未来若通过 JWST 等红外望远镜测定 $2000\,{\rm K}$ 中子星，由于 $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto \sqrt{L_{\rm NS}}$，耦合灵敏度可再推进 3 个数量级。
analysis.reading_entry: Neutron star reheating and ALP Limits
analysis.problem: 在核心坍缩超新星原中子星阶段产生的大量次标量弱相互作用轻介子（如 MeV 级 ALP），虽然部分能够自由逃逸，但其中非相对论成分如何被强引力场束缚并在数百万至数亿年后影响残留中子星的热演化与表面光度，尚未形成自洽系统的致密天体测热计限制。
analysis.method: 采用 SFHo-18.8 超新星数值模拟径向演化模型计算原中子星引力势 $\Phi(r)$ 以及核子轫致辐射 $pp \to ppa$ 与介子转换 $\pi^- p \to na$ 的 ALP 产生截面；通过轨道角动量守恒与相空间积分解出引力束缚粒子云密度增长率 $\left(dn_a / dt\right)_{\rm bind}$；求解衰变演化方程 $n_a(r', t)$，并根据中子星内部及表面吸收立体角 $\Omega(r')$ 计算注入加热光度 $$L_{\rm NS} = \int_{R_{\rm min}}^{R_{\rm max}} 4 \pi r'^2 \, dr' \, \dfrac{m_a}{2} \, \dfrac{n_a(r', t)}{\tau_a} \, \dfrac{\Omega(r')}{4 \pi}$$ 对比观测得到的表面光度 $L_{\rm surf} = L_\infty / (1 - 2GM_{\rm NS}/R_{\rm NS})$ 施加限制。
citation_leads: Introduction: “In this study, we show that an analogous mechanism with $a\to\gamma\gamma$ decays could overheat NSs above luminosities expected from their passive cooling, using which we obtain \emph{for the first time} constraints reaching previously unprobed ALP parameters.”
Neutron star reheating and ALP Limits: “T_{\rm NS} \leq 3.4 \times 10^4 \, {\rm K}, \ L_{\rm NS} \leq 1.4 \times 10^{27} \, {\rm erg/s}”

Neutron star reheating and ALP Limits: “The upper bounds on $g_{a\gamma\gamma}$ scale as $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto m_a^{5/2}$, consistent with using Eqs.~\eqref{eq:dndt_trp} and~\eqref{eq:na_at_t} in Eq.~\eqref{eq:L_NS}. The ceiling on $g_{a\gamma\gamma}$ comes from ALP decays expending the ALP cloud well within the NS lifetime, captured by the falling exponential in Eq.~\eqref{eq:na_at_t}; we set $t=333$~Myr, the spin-down age of J2144~\cite{Guillot:2019ugf}. These lower bounds on $g_{a\gamma\gamma}$ scale as $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto m_a^{-3/2}$”

Neutron star reheating and ALP Limits: “Due to the criterion on luminosity being about $10^6$ smaller, the future reaches on $g_{a\gamma\gamma} \propto \sqrt{L_{\rm NS}}$ are seen to be $10^3$ times smaller than the J2144-based limit.”

Neutron star reheating and ALP Limits: “We make the reasonable assumption here that this ancient NS devoid of an SN remnant was indeed birthed by a core-collapse SN as opposed to a binary white dwarf merger”
ALP production from pion conversion: “However, the production due to pion conversion remains uncertain due to limited knowledge of the thermal pion abundance and in-medium dispersion relation”

analysis.title_zh: z=6.1 处千秒差距尺度喷流最深邃的 X 射线观测
analysis.reason: 研究针对红移最高（$z=6.10$）的千秒差距尺度相对论喷流系统 PSO J0309+27 开展了极深 Chandra X 射线成像与谱学分析，对高能瞬变天体物理中高红移 AGN 相对论喷流的 IC/CMB 辐射机制与能量反馈提供了极端环境下的关键观测约束。
analysis.result: 延展喷流在空间上分解为组分 A 和 B；核区光子指数为 $\Gamma = 1.86^{+0.09}_{-0.09}$，静止系光度 $L_{2-10\,\mathrm{keV}} = 7.22^{+0.62}_{-0.58} \times 10^{45}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$；整体延展喷流呈现更软的谱型（$\Gamma = 2.25^{+0.45}_{-0.44}$），其静止系光度 $L_{2-10\,\mathrm{keV}} = 1.31^{+0.51}_{-0.40} \times 10^{45}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$，占核区光度比例高达 $L_{\rm ext}/L_{\rm core} \sim 18\%$，符合高红移处 CMB 能量密度 $U_{\rm CMB} \propto (1+z)^4$ 急剧上升驱动 IC/CMB 散射增强的图像。
analysis.problem: 高红移相对论喷流的 X 射线辐射起源（如逆康普顿散射宇宙微波背景辐射 IC/CMB 与同步辐射第二类电子成分模型）存在长久争议，而在 $z \gtrsim 6$ 极端距离上，受限于探测光子数极少和空间角分辨率，难以精确限制延展喷流的谱指数 $\Gamma$ 与物理机制。
analysis.method: 利用 Chandra ACIS-S 累积 $360.2\,\mathrm{ksec}$ 深度观测数据，利用多参考源完成平移校准与绝对天体测量注册（残差 $\sim 0.1''$）；在 $0.5\text{--}7.0\,\mathrm{keV}$ 能段开展表面亮度分布与子结构抽取，拟合核区与延展喷流各组分的光谱（固定吸收柱密度 $N_{\rm H} = 1.13 \times 10^{21}\,\mathrm{cm^{-2}}$）；并基于 AXIS 响应矩阵进行模拟对比。

analysis.title_zh: 描绘银河系地府图谱 II：利用 LISA 证认黑洞与中子星双星的策略
analysis.reason: 论文针对空间引力波探测器 LISA 面临的庞大双白矮星（WDWD）前景混淆难题，系统提出了结合轨道频率 $f_{\rm orb}$、啁啾质量 $\mathcal{M}_c$、偏心率 $e$ 与银盘垂直高度 $|z|$ 区分含 BH/NS 双致密天体（BHBH, BHNS, NSNS, BHWD, NSWD）的判据，为银河系致密天体星族演化与高能引力波源的证认提供了明确的参数空间指导。
analysis.result: 在 8 年巡天基准模型下，LISA 预计能探测到约 20–240 个含 BH 或 NS 的双致密天体。通过判据组合可识别 $90\%\text{--}100\%$ 的 BHBH 与 BHNS 以及约 $50\%$ 的 NSNS：(1) 结合引力波旋进光度与时延标度 $\dot{f} \propto f_{\rm orb}^{11/3}$，低频截止 $f_{\rm orb} + \Delta f_{\rm orb} < f_{\rm orb}^{\rm WDWD, min} = 3\times 10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$ 能单独识别约 $70\%$ 的 BHBH；(2) 极限质量判据 $\mathcal{M}_c - \Delta \mathcal{M}_c > 1.25\,M_\odot$ 能确认约 $60\%$ 的 BHBH/BHNS 和 $40\%$ 的 NSNS；(3) 超新星反冲驱动的偏心率测量可额外识别 $10\%\text{--}20\%$ 的 NSNS；(4) 处于 Roche 瓣物质转移（RLOF）阶段的 NSWD（约占 $60\%$）会因轨道膨胀产生特征性的负频率导数 $\dot{f} < 0$，其中约 30 颗可被测出并对应超致密 X 射线双星（UCXB）。
analysis.reading_entry: Methods for distinguishing NS and BH DCOs from WDWDs in lisa
analysis.problem: LISA 探测频段内充斥着数万个未分辨及可分辨的银河系双白矮星（WDWD），导致低发生率但天体物理价值重大的含黑洞（BH）与中子星（NS）双致密天体信号极易被 WDWD 前景淹没或混淆；同时很多低频大质量双星缺乏高精度 $\dot{f}$ 测量，无法直接反解啁啾质量 $\mathcal{M}_c$。
analysis.method: 结合集成于 \texttt{COSMIC} 的 \texttt{STROOPWAFEL} 自适应重要性采样算法与银河系恒星形成历史，生成金属丰度 $Z \in [10^{-4}, 0.03]$ 的大样本 DCO；利用解析误差传递公式模拟考虑探测不确定度的 LISA 参数测量（如频率误差 $\Delta f_{\rm orb}/f_{\rm orb} \propto \rho^{-1} T_{\rm obs}^{-1}$ 与频率导数误差 $\Delta \dot{f}_{\rm dom} \propto \rho^{-1} T_{\rm obs}^{-2}$）；通过测试超新星反冲速度导致的轨道动力学加热以及不同演化判据（如共包层效率 $\alpha_{\rm CE}$ 与稳定吸积极限），评估各观测参数在分辨非 WDWD 系统的灵敏度与纯度。
assumptions: 初生主星质量遵循高质端斜率 $\alpha_{\rm IMF} = -2.3$ 的 Kroupa 初始质量函数，初始质量比 $q \in [q_{\rm min}, 1]$ 均匀分布
WDWD 的最高轨道周期截止对应最小轨道频率 $f_{\rm orb}^{\rm WDWD, min} = 3\times 10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$，最大啁啾质量为双极限 Chandrasekhar 质量白矮星 $\mathcal{M}_c^{\rm WDWD, max} \approx 1.25\,M_\odot$
limits: 低频源往往缺少可靠的频率导数 $\dot{f}$ 测量，必须依赖无 $\dot{f}$ 的轨道频率阈值结合天体物理先验进行贝叶斯推断
NSWD 经历稳定 RLOF 时可能导致定常连续波引力波模板失配，且白矮星质量极限及星风损失模型的不确定性会使可探测系统数产生约 $2\times$ 的浮动
citation_leads: Creating a lisa-detectable population of Milky Way DCOs: “We sample mass ratios, $q \equiv m_2 / m_1$, uniformly in $[q_{\rm min}, 1]$, where $q_{\rm min}$ is set such that the minimum secondary mass is $0.08 \msun$”

The impact of SN kicks on lisa-detectable DCOs: “The number of \lisa detections is mostly insensitive to the change in position due to SN kicks \citep[in agreement with][]{Storck+2023:2023MNRAS.521.2368S}, despite the large changes in scale height.”
Methods for distinguishing NS and BH DCOs from WDWDs in lisa: “A DCO containing a BH or NS can be identified if its chirp mass is confidently above the maximum possible chirp mass of a WDWD.”
Discussion: “Due to the mass ratio of the system, this mass transfer will cause the binary to widen and produce a negative frequency derivative”

Summary and Conclusions: “NSNSs are the most eccentric DCO type of those we considered (Figure~\ref{fig:dco-props}c) and hence have the largest fraction of measurably eccentric sources (Figure~\ref{fig:dco-measured-props}c).”
analysis.research_progress: 明确了超新星反冲虽使 DCO 标高显著增大（BHBH/BHNS/NSNS 标高增大约 3–7 倍），但因 LISA 对空间位置不敏感，总探测数变化小于 $25\%$；建立了利用多参数互补策略从 WDWD 噪声中分离 BH/NS 系统的完整工作流，并揭示了利用 $\dot{f} < 0$ 证认银河系 NSWD 吸积系统的可行性。

figures.caption: Figure 1 : SN kicks broaden the present-day position on DCOs that contain a BH or NS. Each panel shows 2D density distributions (weighted by STROOPWAFEL weights) for the population of DCOs detectable by a 8-year LISA observation duration. The left sides show the location at the moment of DCO formation. The right sides show the position of DCOs at present day, after integrating their Galactic orbits through the Milky Way potential. The solid white lines show the 50% contour and the dashed lines show the 90% contour for each population. Note that the colour scale is different for each panel.
figures.label: Fig. 1

analysis.title_zh: 无声的消逝：在 ZTF 中搜寻失败核心坍缩超新星及对 Rubin 与 Roman 的预测
analysis.reason: 该研究利用大视场时域光学巡天（ZTF）搜寻大质量恒星直接坍缩形成黑洞的失败超新星（FccSN），为超新星中心引擎、黑洞形成通道及大质量前身星消失特征提供了直接的观测发生率限制与未来巡天（LSST/Roman）探测预测，符合高能瞬变源与致密天体形成研究兴趣。
analysis.result: 基于 ZTF 搜寻结果，若候选体皆为非 FccSN，在 99% 置信度下给出 ZTF 观测率上限为 $< 61\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$，推得银河系 FccSN 发生率上限为 $< 147\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$；银河系恒星形成模拟预测的银河系发生率约为 $0.789 \pm 0.022\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$，ZTF 视场与星等限制下预测探测率约为 $0.234 \pm 0.006\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$，显示当前观测零检测对理论模型尚未构成紧致限制。
analysis.problem: 大质量恒星（$\gtrsim 10\ \mathrm{M_\odot}$，尤其是 $16.5 \sim 25\ \mathrm{M_\odot}$）演化末期可能不经历剧烈超新星爆发而直接坍缩为恒星级黑洞（即 FccSN），理论预测占核心坍缩的约 $20\%$，但由于缺乏明亮瞬变辐射，其在银河系及邻近宇宙中的真实发生率和观测特征仍缺乏严格的系统性巡天约束。
analysis.method: 利用 ZTF 约 $1.5\times10^9$ 颗星的强迫测光光变曲线，采用分段线性平坦-下降-平坦模型拟合识别持续变暗源（faders），结合 Gaia DR3 视差、自行及色-星等图剔除大自行星和已知变星；结合 Kroupa IMF（$\frac{\mathrm{d}N}{\mathrm{d}M} = \xi_{0, \alpha} M^{-\alpha}$）、轴对称盘与 Hernquist 核球模型（$\rho_b(r)=\frac{M_b}{2\pi}\frac{a}{r}\frac{1}{(a+r)^3}$）及视线消光模型模拟银河系恒星形成与消光分布，预测 FccSN 观测率并外推至 Rubin/LSST 和 Roman 巡天。
limits: ZTF 搜寻零检测给出的统计上限（$147\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$）远高于模拟预测值（$0.789\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$），尚未对当前理论模型产生强统计约束
citation_leads: Fader Search on ZTF: “First, a preliminary screening is done to filter out clear non-candidates since the fitting algorithm is both time-consuming and computationally expensive.”

Discussion: “The rate obtained from the simulation ($0.789\pm0.022$ per century in the Milky Way) is significantly less than the statistical limiting rate calculated from the null result of the ZTF search (147 per century).”
analysis.research_progress: 建立了利用大规模测光巡天搜寻恒星消失事件的自动化算法，系统给出了银河系 FccSN 的观测发生率上限（$< 147\ \mathrm{century}^{-1}$），并为未来空间及地面大口径巡天（Roman 和 LSST）通过消逝法搜寻黑洞诞生物理过程建立了定量基准。

analysis.title_zh: 射电宁静活动星系核中的核区毫米波连续谱辐射：ALMA能谱与光变研究
analysis.reason: 利用 ALMA 毫米波多波段与短时标光变观测，直接探测射电宁静 AGN（RQ AGN）核区未解吸积盘日冕/微弱致密喷流的非热辐射机制与尺度，对理解致密天体吸积系统的高能 X 射线冕磁活动及相对论喷流形成具有参考价值。
analysis.result: 基于 9 个近邻 RQ AGN 的 100、145 与 233 GHz 准同时观测，测得宽波段毫米谱指数中位值为 $\alpha_{\rm mm} = 0.35\pm0.09$（范围在 $-0.05$ 至 $0.88$ 之间），偏平谱特征符合同步辐射自吸收（SSA）翻折区或自由-自由吸收混合；在 3 个源中探测到 4–11 天内幅度为 30%–55% 的显著时变（$>3\sigma$），约束毫米辐射区尺度上限为 $R_{\rm mm} \le c \times \Delta t \lesssim (3.4\text{--}5.0)\times 10^{-3}\,{\rm pc}$（即 $1.0\times10^3\text{--}1.4\times10^4\,R_{\rm g}$，其中 $R_{\rm g} = GM_{\rm BH}/c^2$），亮温度达 $T_{\rm b} \sim 7.52\times10^7\text{--}1.86\times10^9\,{\rm K}$，排除了热尘埃与自由-自由辐射主导；确立了 145 GHz 与 X 射线的紧密标度关系：$\log(L_{\rm 145GHz}) = (1.42\pm0.19)\log(L_{2-10}) - (22.67\pm8.26)$ 以及 $\log(L_{\rm 145GHz}) = (1.34\pm0.09)\log(L_{14-150}) - (19.69\pm3.90)$。
analysis.problem: 射电宁静 AGN 核区过量毫米波连续谱的物理起源尚不明确，主要争议在于其来自致密 X 射线日冕中相对论/非热电子的同步辐射、致密喷流基底还是热尘埃/自由-自由发射，且此前缺乏准同时宽带毫米能谱及天量级短时标光变来严格限制其辐射尺度与谱形。

analysis.title_zh: 导电球体在磁化等离子体中运动的数值模拟 II：内禀磁场效应与阿尔芬阻力的增强
analysis.reason: 论文通过三维理想 MHD 数值模拟系统研究了携带内禀偶极磁场的导电天体在磁化等离子体流动中的阿尔芬翼（Alfvén wings）与相互作用，给出了阻力系数和耗散功率随内禀磁场比与偶极倾角的定量标度律，对理解磁化致密星在星周介质或伴星风中的磁相互作用及电磁耗散提供了基础物理参考。
analysis.result: 数值模拟表明，当导电球体内禀磁场与背景场反平行（$\theta_{\rm m}=180^\circ$）时，有效阻力半径由磁层顶决定为 $R_{\rm eff} = R(1+b_{\rm in})^{1/3}$，阻力系数遵循 $C_{\rm A} \simeq 1.2(1+b_{\rm in})^{2/3}$；而在非反平行（如平行 $\theta_{\rm m}=0^\circ$）情况下，由于开放连接磁通（linked flux $\Phi_{\rm L}$）的增强，阻力系数显著提高约一个数量级至 $C_{\rm A} \simeq 20\,b_{\rm in}^{2/3}$。综合两项效应得到通用的阿尔芬阻力系数关系式：$$C_{\rm A}(b_{\rm in}, \theta_{\rm m}) \simeq 1.2(1+b_{\rm in})^{2/3} + 20\,b_{\rm in}^{2/3}\cos(\theta_{\rm m}/2)$$耗散功率满足 $P = C_{\rm A}\rho_0 R^2 v_0^2 v_{{\rm A}0} \propto \Phi_{\rm L}$。在亚阿尔芬流（$M_{\rm A} \lesssim 0.1$）极限下，$C_{\rm A}$ 趋于与马赫数无关的常数。
analysis.problem: 量化内禀偶极磁场及其与背景磁场的相对夹角如何改变导电球体运动引发的磁场重联、连接磁通量（linked flux）以及阿尔芬阻力和能量耗散功率。
analysis.method: 使用理想 MHD 代码 PLUTO 在球坐标系 $(r,\theta,\phi)$ 下开展三维数值模拟，绝热指数设为 $\gamma = 5/3$。磁场分解为解析背景场与演化扰动场 $\mathbf{B} = \mathbf{B}_{\rm bkg} + \delta\mathbf{B}$，在球面上施加无滑动冻结边界条件 $\mathbf{v}=0$ 与零切向电场，计算包围导体的总动量通量积分以获取阻力与机械功率。

analysis.title_zh: 半人马座 Omega 中 Chandra X 射线源的多波段机器学习分类
analysis.reason: 该工作首次将多波段机器学习分类管线 MUWCLASS 应用于致密星团环境（球状星团 omega Cen），结合 Chandra、HST、JWST 与 MeerKAT 深度射电数据对 200 余个暗弱致密天体与双星系统（MSP、CV、qLMXB 等）进行了系统性交叉匹配与分类证认，对理解球状星团中致密天体族群演化、蜘蛛脉冲星及低质量 X 射线双星的物理机制具有实用参考价值。
analysis.result: 研究在 omega Cen 中确立了 25 个可靠的星团成员 X 射线源，若计入候选激变变星（CV）、毫秒脉冲星（MSP）和巨星色球活动双星（AB）则达 44 个（与理论预期的 $\sim 48$ 个成员一致）。确认了 18 个背景 AGN、12 颗前景恒星、6 个巨星 AB、9 个 CV，以及双星 MSP Q 与黑寡妇蜘蛛脉冲星 MSP K；同时发现了 7 个候选 MSP（含 2 个 WD-MSP 双星候选体）。此外，在 7 颗孤立 MSP 周围 $3\arcsec$ 范围内检测到 $\sim 5$ 颗白矮星（WD）超额（亮 WD 超额显著性 $> 3\sigma$），揭示出致密星团环境下可能存在被动力学瓦解或处于极宽轨道的 WD 伴星遗迹。
analysis.problem: 在球状星团这类极端拥挤的星族环境中，约 80%–90% 的低光度 X 射线源缺乏明确的物理分类，存在严重的源混叠、光学对应体误配率高以及背景 AGN 污染严重等观测矛盾。
analysis.method: 利用 MUWCLASS 机器学习管线结合 NWAY 概率交叉匹配方法，整合 Chandra CSC 2.1、HST oMEGACat、JWST 及 MeerKAT 射电巡天（探测极限 $\lesssim 10\,\mu\mathrm{Jy}$，对应光度 $\lesssim 5\times 10^{26}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$）；采用分段高斯抽样和合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）平衡数据类别；利用高斯过程（GP）核函数 $k(x_{i},x_{j})=\exp\left(-\frac{d(x_{i},x_{j})^{2}}{2l^{2}}\right)+(\sigma_{0}^{2}+x_{i}\cdot x_{j})^{2}$（其中参数限制在 $100 \le l \le 200\,\mathrm{nm}$，偏置 $3 \le \sigma_{0} \le 1000$）对多波段缺失测光进行内插补全。

analysis.title_zh: 利用 FLARE 对 ZTF 暂现源进行测光分类与分类体系外异常检测
analysis.reason: 本文提出了针对大视场时域巡天（ZTF 及未来 Rubin/LSST）的测光分类与异常检测框架 FLARE，重点针对超亮超新星（SLSN）、潮汐瓦解事件（TDE）等稀有高能暂现源以及快蓝光学暂现源（FBOT，如 AT 2018cow）和伽马射线暴（GRB）等域外奇异事件的快速筛选与报警，对高能瞬变天体物理巡天证认具有参考价值。
analysis.result: 通过结合 160 个光变曲线特征与宿主星系测光、点源背景及基于平坦 $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ 宇宙学模型（$H_0 = 70\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, $\Omega_m = 0.3$）下由光度红移导出的伪绝对星等 $M_{\mathrm{pseudo}} = m_{\mathrm{peak}} - 5\log_{10}[d_L(z_{\mathrm{phot}})/10\,\mathrm{pc}]$，模型宏 $F_1$ 达到 $0.83\pm0.02$。在 $1\%$ 虚警率（FPR）下，利用基于 log-sum-exp logits 的 energy 打分器及主动复核循环，仅检查 $6\%$ 的警报流即可召回 $60\%$ 的分类系统外异常天体，相比静态排序减少了 $45\%$ 的人工审核工作量，并在实机回放中成功捕获 FBOT AT 2018cow 及 GRB 对应体。
analysis.problem: 海量时域巡天警报流（ZTF 每晚数十万至百万级，Rubin 预计千万级）与极度稀缺的光谱后随资源之间存在尖锐矛盾；传统测光分类器无法识别未包含在分类体系内的罕见/奇异高能物理事件（如 FBOT、GRB 等域外天体），且多历元重复报警易导致虚警累积与样本漂移。
analysis.method: 构建了两级 LightGBM 树状分类器（第一级 5 分类区分 SN Ia、SN CC$^+$、AGN、TDE、CV，第二级通过 $P(\mathrm{SLSN}) = P(\mathrm{SN\,CC}^{+}) P(\mathrm{SLSN}\mid\mathrm{SN\,CC}^{+})$ 细分 SLSN），结合外部背景 dropout（30% 丢弃率）；集成 LUNA 工具箱中 14 种打分器的异常检测层；引入共形预测集（Mondrian conformal prediction）提供不确定度；并构建全生命周期统计量 $P_{\mathrm{life}} = \min_k \pi_k$（其中 $\pi_k = (1 + \#\{i : m^{\mathrm{ref}}_{i,k} \le m_k\}) / (1 + N_k)$，对运行极小值 $m_k = \min_{j\le k} p_j$ 进行校准）控制单位时间虚警率。
assumptions: 假设宇宙学参数为平坦 $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ 模型，取 $H_0 = 70\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, $\Omega_m = 0.3$ 用于由 $z_{\mathrm{phot}}$ 计算伪绝对星等。
limits: 对于极端稀疏且缺乏母类别的稀有瞬变源（如 FBOT、LBV、Ca-rich 暂现源），盲异常检测 AUROC 仅为 0.73，同一家族邻近检索难以稳定检出同类；完全重训练可能导致对特定单次事件（如 GRB 对应体）的报警能力丢失。

analysis.title_zh: 利用 14 年 IceCube 缪子径迹数据搜寻爱因斯坦探针（EP）探测到的快速 X 射线暂现源的高能中微子
analysis.reason: 该工作结合了爱因斯坦探针（EP）最新探测到的 27 个具有红移证认的快速 X 射线暂现源（FXTs）与 IceCube 14 年公开缪子径迹数据（IceTracks-DR2），检验了 FXTs 源自偏轴喷流、阻滞喷流（choked jets）或低光度 GRB 时的强子加速与高能中微子发射预言，为瞬变源中心引擎物理与多信使观测提供了经验通量限制。
analysis.result: 在 27 个 FXT 位置均未发现具有统计显著性的高能中微子超额。最大检验统计量为 EP240801a（$\mathrm{TS}=4.77$，局部 $p=0.04$）。计算给出的 90% 置信度微分缪子中微子通量上限处于 $\mathcal{O}(10^{-10})\ \mathrm{GeV\ cm^{-2}\ s^{-1}}$ 量级；在假定能谱指数 $\Gamma=2.0$ 及转折能量 $E_0=100\ \mathrm{TeV}$ 下，最严格的上限由 EP241021a 给出：$E^2 \Phi(E) = 2.1 \times 10^{-10}\ \mathrm{GeV\ cm^{-2}\ s^{-1}}$。
analysis.problem: FXTs 的物理起源尚存争议（如偏轴或阻滞 GRB 喷流、超新星激波破越、磁星等）。若 FXTs 包含相对论喷流强子加速过程，应伴随高能中微子产生；研究需要检验来自此类天体方向是否存在稳态或持久的中微子辐射，并对阻滞喷流模型预言做出定量约束。
analysis.method: 采用 IceCube 点源非切片最大似然法（使用 SkyLLH 软件包），针对 27 个源坐标分别在 14 年（2008–2022 年）的 IceTracks-DR2 数据中最大化似然比：$$\mathcal{L}(n_s,\gamma) = \prod_{i=1}^N \left(\frac{n_s}{N} S_i(\gamma) + \left(1 - \frac{n_s}{N}\right) B_i\right)$$，构建检验统计量 $\mathrm{TS} = 2 \log [\mathcal{L}(\hat{n}_s,\hat{\gamma})/\mathcal{L}(n_s=0)]$。通过注入不同信号事件数（假定 $\Phi(E) = \Phi_0 (E/E_0)^{-\gamma}$ 且取 $\gamma=2.0$）开展模拟试验，推导 90% C.L. 信号数上限 $n_s^{90}$ 及通量上限。
assumptions: 分析采用时间积分模式（time-integrated），假设暂现源所在天区位置存在持久的中微子发射过剩。
limits: 因公开的 IceTracks-DR2 径迹数据仅覆盖到 2022 年 5 月，而 EP 探测的 FXTs 均发生于 2024–2026 年，无重合时间窗口，无法实施与爆发时刻相符的时变/符合触发搜寻。
得到的中微子信号数上限 $n_s^{90}$ 相比于各向同性等效能量 $E_{\mathrm{iso}} \sim 10^{53}\ \mathrm{erg}$ 的阻滞喷流理论预言仍高出约一个数量级，加之多数 FXTs 的 $E_{\mathrm{iso}} < 10^{53}\ \mathrm{erg}$，目前尚无法直接排除阻滞喷流模型。

analysis.title_zh: 新 f(R,T) 理论下扩展 Tolman III 内部解的轴向引力微扰
analysis.reason: 文章基于新 $f(R,T)$ 修正引力形式体系推导了常密度超致密星的轴向微扰方程与有效势，并给出了引力波准正规模（QNM）与回声（GW echoes）时延及特征频率，与 GW170817 回声信号和 NICER 观测半径限制进行了对照，对致密天体微扰与致密星内部物理研究有理论参考价值。
analysis.result: 在线性修正引力 $f(R,T) = R + 2\chi T$ 框架下，流体声速限制 $0 < c_s^2 < 1$（其中 $c_s^2 = \frac{1}{3} + \frac{8\pi}{3\chi}$）约束耦合参数 $\chi \in [-8\pi, 4\pi]$。推导出修正的 Buchdahl 紧致度极限 $\beta_{\rm B} = \frac{128\pi^2 + 8\pi\chi - \chi^2}{288\pi^2}$ 以及主能量条件极限 $\beta_{\rm DEC} = \frac{48\pi^2 + 8\pi\chi - \chi^2}{128\pi^2}$。其轴向微扰有效势 $V(x) = \frac{e^{\nu}}{x^3} \left\{ l(l+1)x+ 4\pi x^3 \left[\rho\left(1+\frac{\chi}{4\pi}\right)-p\left(1+\frac{3\chi}{4\pi}\right)\right] -6 m(x)\right\}$ 具有更深的势阱；采用 NICER 观测半径 $R = 11.4\,\mathrm{km}$ 时，在 $\chi=0.96\pi$、紧致度 $\beta=0.4662702$ 下计算得到引力波回声时延 $\tau_{\rm echo} = 2.39\times 10^2\,\mathrm{ms}$，对应特征回声频率 $f_{\rm echo} = 72.11\,\mathrm{Hz}$，与 GW170817 报道的 $\sim 72\,\mathrm{Hz}$ 信号一致（广义相对论预言为 $5.19\times 10^2\,\mathrm{Hz}$）。

analysis.problem: 在传统 $f(R,T)$ 理论中由于物质拉氏量对度规的二阶泛函变分存在模糊性，需引入新的作用量变分体系以消除对拉氏量形式依赖；同时探索超致密天体在此类修正引力下是否能在满足能量条件的前提下解释引力波回声观测信号。
analysis.method: 采用将四速度归一化条件纳入变分的新形式体系，选取无曲率-能量动量交叉项的线性作用量 $f(R,T) = R + 2\chi T$ 并推导修正 TOV 方程；针对扩展 Tolman III 解析解引入 Gegenbauer 展开与 Tortoise 坐标求解轴向 Regge-Wheeler 波动方程；运用 WKB/Bohr-Sommerfeld（BS）方法求解复本征频率 $\omega_n = \omega_r + i\omega_i$ 并数值积分计算回声传播时延 $\tau_{\rm echo} = \int_0^{3M} \sqrt{-g_{rr}/g_{tt}}\,dr$。

analysis.title_zh: LSST时代室女座星系团超新星发现预估
analysis.reason: 该论文属于巡天产额统计预测，通过室女座星系团星系恒星质量函数与经验超新星发生率，估算LSST与Shadow协同巡天在10年期内探测到的极早期（爆发后1–2天）超新星数目；未包含超新星中心引擎、激波破越与CSM相互作用物理建模、FRB/PRS或致密天体高能辐射机制，与核心研究方向无实质联系。
analysis.result: 通过对室女座星系团4个子结构（Cluster A core, R1, R2及Cluster B）的恒星质量函数积分，得到总恒星质量约为 $M_* \sim 39 \times 10^{12}\,M_\odot$。在假设10年巡天、每年200个晴夜、1天有效采样间隔的条件下，蒙特卡洛模拟预估LSST与Shadow项目将在室女座星系团内发现 $17.74 \pm 4.2$ 颗 Type Ia 超新星和 $52.48 \pm 7.22$ 颗塌缩型（CC）超新星（即每年约 1–2 颗 SNe Ia 和 5–6 颗 CC SNe），且均能在爆发后 1–2 天内被捕获。
analysis.problem: 预估在LSST及其互补项目（DECam Shadow）以1天高频采样监测近邻室女座星系团（$D \simeq 16.5\text{ Mpc}$）时，能够在爆发后数小时至1-2天内捕获的不同类型极早期超新星（infant SNe）的统计发现数目。
analysis.method:
利用 Schechter 质量函数：
$$\phi(m) = \ln(10)\cdot \phi^* \cdot \exp[-10^{m-m_c}] \cdot 10^{(\alpha+1)(m-m_c)}$$\n积分获得各子结构与星系类型的总恒星质量；结合按质量归一化的超新星发生率（SNuM），计算单日事件概率 $p_{\rm SN} = R_{\rm SN} / 365.25$；基于每年 200 个观测夜进行 1000 次独立的蒙特卡洛随机抽样，统计10年巡天期内的发现数及均方差。
assumptions: 假设LSST与Shadow协同巡天每年可对室女座星系团实现200个晴夜的有效全覆盖观测，且这200个观测夜均完全晴朗无阻碍。
假设超新星在一整年中的爆发概率分布是均匀恒定的（$p_{\rm SN} = R_{\rm SN} / 365.25$）。
limits: 该计算为纯统计推演，未纳入设备硬件故障、恶劣气候等长时间巡天中不可避免的实际工程与观测损耗。

Introduction: “Note that this is purely a statistical analysis, thus, it does not take into account technical and observational challenges, like instrument failure, severe weather, etc.”

Results: “The probability of the appearance of a SN in a particular galaxy type and substructure of Virgo on a particular day can be estimated as $p_{SN} = R_{SN} / 365.25$”
Results: “We assumed that all these 200 nights are clear, which is an optimistic assumption.”
Results: “Summing up all the expected discovery numbers, we get $\sim17.74 \pm 4.2$ SNe Ia and $\sim52.48 \pm 7.22$ SNe CC in the entire Virgo cluster during the 10 year-long lifetime of LSST”

analysis.title_zh: 千新星能谱辐射的相对论动力学演化
analysis.reason: 文章系统结合了等到达时间面（EATS）和多普勒集束效应，构建了千新星中等相对论膨胀抛射物的动力学演化模型，量化了相对论效应对 AT2017gfo 早期能谱及物理参数推断的系统偏差，对双中子星并合抛射物物理与高能激波探测具有直接参考价值。
analysis.result: 研究发现对于中等相对论性膨胀（$\beta \lesssim 0.3$），光行时延迟效应（使边缘温度升高）与多普勒增亮效应（使视线方向 $\mu \approx 1$ 增亮）作用方向相反并发生近似抵消，从而使观测温度呈现近各向同性，合理解释了 AT2017gfo 的准黑体特征；若忽略该相对论几何动力学效应，推断的动力学温度将被高估最高 $7.6\%$、速度 $\beta$ 将被高估约 $11.9\%$。对 AT2017gfo 拟合给出有效膨胀速度随时间自 $\beta \simeq 0.199 \pm 0.009$ 降至 $0.122 \pm 0.006$，有效观测温度从 $5428\ \mathrm{K}$ 降至 $3061\ \mathrm{K}$，简并组合量 $\kappa M_{\mathrm{ej}}$ 自 $(3.8^{+4.0}_{-1.5})\times 10^{-2}$ 微增至 $(6.5^{+3.9}_{-2.4})\times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{cm^2\,g^{-1}\,M_\odot}$。
analysis.problem: 以往千新星谱辐射模型多采用静态几何或唯象幂律温度演化（$T_{\mathrm{emit}} \propto t^{-p}$），忽略了从光厚到光薄自洽过渡的内部热演化方程以及等到达时间面（EATS）与多普勒效应的动力学修正，导致在解释早期中等相对论膨胀（$\beta \sim 0.1-0.3$）特征时引入了未知偏差。
analysis.method: 基于热力学第一定律与幂律放射性加热率 $\epsilon(t) = (f c^2 / t_c) (t_c / t)^{1+\alpha}$，结合扩散时间向光薄过渡的时标 $t_c = [3\kappa M_{\mathrm{ej}}/(4\pi v^2)]^{1/2}$，建立辐射能量密度 $U(t)$ 的自洽演化方程：$$\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t^4 U) = \frac{3M_{\mathrm{ej}}}{4\pi v^3} \epsilon(t) t (1 - e^{-t_c^2/t^2}) - \frac{\pi v c}{\kappa M_{\mathrm{ej}}} \frac{t^5 U}{1 + t^2/(2t_c^2)}$$；随后应用 EATS 时间映射 $t(\mu, t_{\mathrm{obs}}) = t_{\mathrm{obs}} / (1 - \beta\mu)$ 与多普勒变换 $T_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mu, t_{\mathrm{obs}}) = T_{\mathrm{emit}}(t) / [\gamma(1 - \beta\mu)]$ 积分得到观测能谱 $L_\lambda(t_{\mathrm{obs}}) = 8\pi^2 \int_\beta^1 B_\lambda[T_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mu, t_{\mathrm{obs}})] R^2(\mu, t_{\mathrm{obs}})\mu \mathrm{d}\mu$；采用自由度 $\nu=4$ 的 Student-$t$ 似然函数进行 MCMC 参数拟合以有效抑制特征吸收线的局部残差偏离。
assumptions: 辐射在局域发射区满足局部热动平衡（LTE）的黑体谱分布
limits: 扩散近似仅在早期光厚期严格成立，进入光薄期后偏离 LTE 将导致系统偏差

analysis.problem: EP260321a 是伴随 SN Ic-BL 2026gzf 的超新星激波破越事件，其 X 射线破越辐射能量高达 $E_X \simeq 8.7\times 10^{47}\ {\rm erg}$（比经典事件 XRO 080109/SN 2008D 高约 40 倍），但后续射电观测未被探测到（光度比 SN 2008D 至少低 1 个量级），且在爆发后 $t \lesssim 1\ {\rm d}$ 呈现异常明亮的光学辐射（$L_\nu \sim 10^{27}\text{--}10^{28}\ {\rm erg\ s^{-1}\ Hz^{-1}}$），裸沃夫-拉叶星（Wolf-Rayet）核心的激波冷却辐射无法解释这一光学超亮现象与射电暗弱之间的矛盾。
analysis.method:
1. 基于激波破越光深度条件 $\tau_{\rm w,bo} \simeq \kappa \rho_0 \Delta R_{\rm bo} \simeq c/v_{\rm bo}$ 与辐射能量 $E_{\rm bo} \simeq \frac{1}{2} M_{\rm bo} v_{\rm bo}^2$，分析了局部热动平衡解（$\beta_{\rm bo} \lesssim 0.05$）与光子匮乏解（$\beta_{\rm bo} \gtrsim 0.05$）的辐射特征；
2. 建立幂律速度分布 $E(>\beta)=E_{\rm f,0}(\beta/\beta_{\rm f,0})^{-q_{\rm ej}}$ 驱动的前向激波同步辐射与自吸收模型，利用射电上限对破越速度给出严格限制；
3. 建立激波加热致密 CSM 壳层的膨胀冷却与辐射扩散模型，求解热光度演化 $L_{\rm cool}(t)=(E_{\rm int,0}/t_{d,0})\exp[-(t+t^2/2t_{\rm exp})/t_{d,0}]$（其中初态扩散时标 $t_{d,0}=\kappa f_\Delta M_{\rm CSM}/(4\pi\chi c R_{\rm bo})$），并在 Rayleigh--Jeans 极限下推导光学单频峰值时标 $t_{\nu,p}=t_{\exp}[(6t_{d,0}/t_{\exp})^{1/2}-1]$ 及峰值光度 $L_{\nu,p}^{\rm RJ}$。

Observational Inference of the Shock Velocity: “Radio observations provide an independent constraint on the shock velocities.”

Cooling-emission Model: “Thus, the shocked CSM naturally releases its trapped radiation on a sub-day timescale and can account for the bright early optical emission of EP260321a.”

figures.caption: Figure 1: Pre-breakout and breakout configurations. Schematic comparison of the environments inferred for XRO 080109/SN 2008D and EP260321a/SN 2026gzf. In all panels, the blue region denotes the unshocked CSM, while the region between the SN ejecta and the forward shock denotes the shocked CSM. Panels (A) and (B) show the XRO 080109 case, in which the SN ejecta expand directly into an extended Wolf–Rayet wind and shock breakout occurs within the wind. Panel (B) depicts the onset of breakout, when the shock enters the SBO region. The breakout phase ends after the shock has traversed its radial extent, Δ ​ R bo \Delta R_{\rm bo} . The breakout shock is relatively fast, v bo ∼ 0.2 v_{\rm bo}\sim 0.2 – 0.3 ​ c 0.3c , and the SBO region is geometrically thick, with Δ ​ R bo ∼ R bo \Delta R_{\rm bo}\sim R_{\rm bo} . Panels (C) and (D) show the EP260321a case, in which the SN ejecta first propagate through a low-density region before encountering a compact, dense CSM shell. Breakout occurs near the outer edge of the shell, at R bo ≃ R CSM ∼ 10 13 ​ cm R_{\rm bo}\simeq R_{\rm CSM}\sim 10^{13}\ {\rm cm} . The shell has a radial width of Δ ​ R CSM ∼ 0.1 ​ R CSM \Delta R_{\rm CSM}\sim 0.1R_{\rm CSM} , as inferred from the optical cooling emission (Sect. III ). Panel (D) likewise depicts the onset of breakout, when the shock enters the thin outer SBO region. The breakout velocity is much lower, v bo ∼ 0.05 ​ c v_{\rm bo}\sim 0.05c . In this case, Δ ​ R bo ≪ Δ ​ R CSM \Delta R_{\rm bo}\ll\Delta R_{\rm CSM} , so only a thin outer portion of the CSM shell contributes to the prompt breakout emission, whereas radiation deposited deeper in the shocked CSM remains trapped and emerges later as cooling emission.

analysis.title_zh: 大麦哲伦云中超级气泡 DEM L36 的 XMM-Newton 观测视角
analysis.reason: 该研究利用 XMM-Newton 及多波段数据对大麦哲伦云超级气泡 DEM L36 进行了详细的高能 X 射线能谱与能量收支解析，直接涉及超新星反馈、星际介质空洞演化与激波/热气体相互作用，为超新星中心引擎与环境反馈提供了实测约束样本。
analysis.result: 测得 DEM L36 内部软 X 射线热等离子体温度为 $kT \approx 0.17\ \mathrm{keV}$（$0.16\text{--}0.18\ \mathrm{keV}$），总气体热能约为 $(3.56 \pm 0.90) \times 10^{51}\ \mathrm{erg}$。假定等压状态下，东区压力满足 $P/k = (n_e + 1.1n_\mathrm{H})T = 2.31 n_\mathrm{H} T = (7.45 \pm 1.96) \times 10^5\ \mathrm{K\ cm^{-3}}$。星团历史机械能输入估算达 $(8.72 \pm 3.02) \times 10^{51}\ \mathrm{erg}$，显著大于实测气体储存能量，表明其存在通过破裂（blowout）向外泄漏冷却的能量损失，同时高观测气体质量证实了冷壳层的质量加载（mass-loading）效应。
analysis.problem: 超级气泡在经典恒星风和超新星吹泡模型下的膨胀率与能量收支存在差异（growth rate discrepancy 与能量缺失问题），且 DEM L36 内部热气体结构、能量平衡与致密天体/超新星遗迹（SNR）关联尚待多波段高能观测证实。
analysis.method: 利用 XMM-Newton EPIC-pn 和 MOS2 数据进行点源掩模、QPB 背景扣除与 X 射线能谱分析，采用 APEC 碰撞电离平衡（CIE）热薄等离子体模型（固定金属丰度 $Z = 0.5\,Z_\odot$）拟合热气体发射；结合 Starburst99 星族合成代码和 MIST 等时线估算星团质量与机械能注入。
assumptions: 假定 X 射线发射气体处于碰撞电离平衡（CIE），金属丰度固定为大麦哲伦云参考值 $Z = 0.5\,Z_\odot$。
假定整个体积内等离子体处于等压状态：$P/k = 2.31 n_\mathrm{H} T$。
citation_leads: Analysis and results: “We fitted each region with an absorbed soft thermal plasma component (APEC, \citealt{smith2001collisional}) in CIE with abundances fixed at the LMC metallicity value of 0.5 $Z/Z_\odot$”

analysis.title_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四次观测运行后半期（O4b）快速 X 射线暂现源（FXT）的引力波搜寻
analysis.reason: 利用 LVK O4b 运行数据对爱因斯坦探针（EP）新发现的快速 X 射线暂现源（FXT）样本进行了首次成体系的非模化相干引力波定向搜寻，给出了致密双星并合与恒星塌缩等前身星模型的排除距离与引力波辐射能量上限，对理解 FXT 的中心引擎具有直接的多信使约束价值。
analysis.result: 在 EP 探测到的 64 例 FXT 中筛选出 19 个满足 LVK 运行条件的源，所有源的显著性 $p$ 值均与背景噪声涨落一致（如 EP240414a 的 $p=0.068$、EP250108a 的 $p=0.763$），未探测到显著的引力波信号。针对伴随宽线超新星 SN 2025kg 的个源 EP250108a（红移 $z = 0.17641$，光度距离 $D_L = 880.6\,\mathrm{Mpc}$），在 $70\text{--}300\,\mathrm{Hz}$ 频段内通过 $E_{\mathrm{GW},90\%}=\frac{2}{5}\frac{\pi^{2}c^{3}}{G}r^{2}f_{0}^{2}h_{\mathrm{rss},90\%}^{2}$ 导出的引力波辐射能量 90% 置信度上限为 $E_{\mathrm{GW},90\%} \in [6.715\times 10^{-2},\, 5.506\times 10^{-1}]\,M_{\odot}c^{2}$，受限于现有引力波探测视距，尚无法直接触及多数 FXT 所处的深空宿主距离。
analysis.reading_entry: II.2 Upper Limit Estimation and Exclusion Distance
analysis.problem: 快速 X 射线暂现源（FXT）的物理本质、前身星系统以及辐射中心引擎（如双中子星并合、恒星坍缩、超新星激波破越或离轴伽马射线暴余辉）存在较大争议，急需通过探测其成协的引力波爆发信号来确证其动力学起源。
analysis.method: 采用非模化相干突发搜寻算法 X-Pipeline，在 H1、L1 和 V1 网络上设定 $[20, 500]\,\mathrm{Hz}$ 目标频带。以 X 射线触发时间为基准设定源内窗口 $[T_0 - 600\,\mathrm{s}, T_0 + 60\,\mathrm{s}]$ 及长 $10800\,\mathrm{s}$ 的背景窗，利用非相干能量关系 $\log_{10}I = a(\log_{10}E)^2 + c$ 剔除毛刺；向背景注入圆形正弦-高斯（CSG，$Q=9$，$f_0 \in [70, 300]\,\mathrm{Hz}$）、致密双星（BNS/NSBH）以及吸积盘不稳定性（ADI）模拟波形，测定各模型的 90% 置信度排除距离与引力波应变/能量上限：$$E_{\mathrm{GW},90\%}=\frac{2}{5}\frac{\pi^{2}c^{3}}{G}r^{2}f_{0}^{2}h_{\mathrm{rss},90\%}^{2}$$
assumptions: 注入的圆形正弦-高斯波形（CSG）、致密双星并合波形（BNS/NSBH）和吸积盘不稳定性波形（ADI）能够有效代表潜在的电磁与引力波辐射物理机制。

analysis.title_zh: 打破对称性：倾斜弱磁中子星表面扩散层的X射线偏振
analysis.reason: 针对IXPE在弱磁中子星X射线双星中发现的偏振角偏转及高偏振度现象，论文打破传统的自转轴-轨道轴对齐假设，构建了倾斜中子星表面扩散层（SL）偏振辐射解析模型与遮挡几何，对致密天体吸积几何和高能偏振观测解释有参考价值。
analysis.result: 打破轴对称后，吸积盘的物理遮挡使扩散层（SL）偏振面可偏离吸积盘法线方向并呈任意取向（偏振角主要由几何取向角校正量 $\tan\chi_{\rm m} = \frac{\sin\eta\sin\Phi}{\sin\eta\cos i\cos\Phi - \cos\eta\sin i}$ 决定），同时有效提升了净偏振度（在部分参数下 $\mathrm{PD} > 2\%$）；对于固定能段 $E = 5\text{ keV}$ 及几何依赖边界 $\theta_{\rm min} = 90^\circ - \eta$，各向同性视角下探测到 $\mathrm{PD} \ge 1.0\%$ 的概率随倾角 $\eta$ 从 $5^\circ$ 时的 $28\%$ 下降到 $30^\circ$ 时的 $7.8\%$，成功解释了 Cir X-1（$\mathrm{PA} = -12^\circ, \mathrm{PD} = 1.4\%$）与 GX 5$-$1 等源的偏振角错位与偏振度分布。
analysis.problem: 传统弱磁中子星（WMNS）理论假定中子星自转轴与吸积盘轨道轴平行，预言扩散层偏振度极低（$\mathrm{PD} \le 1.5\%$）且偏振角平行于吸积盘法线，无法解释IXPE在Cir X-1、GX 5$-$1等源中观测到的偏振角非平行偏转（如夹角达 $50^\circ\sim 60^\circ$）以及局部能段偏振度偏高的问题。
analysis.method: 建立中子星自转轴相对双星轨道轴存在倾斜角 $\eta$ 与方位角 $\Phi$ 的几何框架，视线方向在自转系下有效倾角满足 $\cos i_{*} = \cos i\cos\eta + \sin i\sin\eta\cos\Phi$；结合 Beloborodov 广义相对论光线弯曲近似 $\cos\alpha \approx 1 - (1-u)(1-\cos\psi)$、吸积盘平面遮挡条件 $\hat{\boldsymbol{n}}\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol{z}} > 0$（即 $\cos\eta\cos\theta + \sin\eta\sin\theta\cos(\Phi_{*} - \phi) > 0$）与半无限电子散射大气斯托克斯偏振积分 $P_{\rm es}(\alpha') = -0.1171(1-\cos\alpha')/(1+3.582\cos\alpha')$，计算观测能谱及偏振参量空间。
assumptions: 中子星外时空采用 Schwarzschild 度规近似光线弯曲效应，光子出射角遵循 Beloborodov (2002) 近似关系。

analysis.title_zh: 移动网格上包含康普顿散射的多群辐射扩散算法：在 RICH 中的实现与在潮汐瓦解事件（TDE）中的应用
analysis.reason: 在高能瞬变源与潮汐瓦解事件（TDE）中，激波与吸积流动产生的硬 X 射线辐射高度依赖康普顿散射与能量再分配。该工作首次在移动 Voronoi 网格辐射流体代码 rich 中实现了基于精确热康普顿核的半隐式多群通量限制扩散（FLD）模块，解决了极端温差和超长流体步长下的非线性耦合稳定性难题，并直接量化了 TDE 喷嘴激波区康普顿硬化对早期 X 射线闪（X-ray flash）的主导贡献。
analysis.result: 在 $10^6\,M_\odot$ 黑洞瓦解 $0.5\,M_\odot$ 恒星（回落时标 $t_{\rm fb} \approx 26.6\,\mathrm{days}$）的三维模拟中，在 $0.66\,t_{\rm fb}$ 处近星点喷嘴激波（nozzle shock）诱发各向同性等效光度达 $\overline{L}_X^{\rm ph} \approx 10^{42}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$ 的 X 射线闪。在激波区，气体温度远高于康普顿温度（$T_{\rm gas} > T_C$），逆康普顿冷却参数 $A_{\rm IC} \equiv (U_C - D_C)/(U_C + D_C) \approx 1$；康普顿向高能能谱重分配产生 X 射线的功率 $\dot{E}_{X,C}$ 比局部热辐射快数十至数百倍，康普顿耦合份额 $f_C = |Q_C|/(|Q_C| + |Q_{\rm abs}|) \approx 1$。在 X 射线热化半径与散射层之间，康普顿注入率与逃逸 X 射线光度相当，主导了 TDE 早期的高能辐射特征。
analysis.problem: 在相对论与高能瞬变天体（如 TDE 喷嘴激波及超爱丁顿外流）中，康普顿散射将全波段辐射能群强非线性耦合，且局域康普顿平衡时标 $t_{\rm spec} = 2E_{\rm rad}/\sum_{g'} |C_{g'}|$ 远短于流体动力学推进步长 $\Delta t$（即 $t_{\rm dyn}/t_{\rm spec} \gg 1$），传统隐式蒙特卡洛或显式多群辐射算法在大温差下极易发散或计算代价极其高昂。
analysis.method:
在动网格辐射流体代码 rich 中构建了基于精确热康普顿核的半隐式多群扩散算法：
1. 控制方程采用共动系通量限制扩散（FLD），扩散系数满足 $D_g = c\lambda_g / \kappa_{R,g}$，结合角平均诱导散射项（光子占据数 $n_g = \frac{h^3 c^3}{8\pi \nu_g^3} E_g$）；
2. 引入康普顿核对辐射能密度 $U_r$ 的线性展开 $\mathcal{C}[\sigma_s; I, I]^{n+1} \simeq \mathcal{C}[\sigma_s^n; I^{n+1}, I^n] + (U_r^{n+1} - U_r^n)\mathcal{C}'[\partial \sigma_s^n/\partial U_r; I^n, I^n]$，构建广义 Fleck 因子 $f = [1 + \frac{c\Delta t}{\bar{c}_v}(\kappa_P + \kappa_C)]^{-1}$，其中热容比 $\bar{c}_v \equiv \frac{\partial u_m}{\partial U_r} = \frac{c_v}{4a_R T^3}$，并成对修正微观截面比率 $F_{g'g}(T)$ 强制满足群间细致平衡与光子数守恒 $N_\gamma = \sum_g E_g / \nu_g$；
3. 采用 MPI 并行与预条件 BiCGSTAB 求解非对称稀疏线性系统 $\vec{M}\vec{E}^{n+1} = \vec{b}$，在 $f<0$ 时截断受激散射保证绝对数值稳定性。
assumptions: 在多群通量限制扩散（FLD）近似下假定近各向同性辐射场以闭合诱导康普顿散射项
citation_leads: Multigroup Radiation Diffusion with Compton Scattering on a Moving Mesh: Implementation in rich and Application to Tidal Disruption Events: “We extend the multigroup flux-limited diffusion module of the moving-mesh RHD code rich to include Compton scattering with the exact thermal Compton kernel.”

II.2 Semi-Implicit Treatment of Compton Scattering: “The Compton terms are then nonlinear in the material temperature, through $\sigma_{s}$, and in the radiation field, through the induced scattering.”
VIII.3 Spectral Change Rate: “Where $t_{\rm dyn}/t_{\rm spec}\geq 1$, Compton scattering changes the local spectrum faster than the gas moves.”

VIII.5 Direction of the Redistribution: “The sign of $Q_{C}$ distinguishes Compton heating of the gas, $Q_{C}>0$, from inverse-Compton cooling, $Q_{C}<0$. Since the radiation gains energy where the gas is cooled, the sign of $Q_{C}$ also gives the net direction of the”

IX Conclusions: “The gas near the nozzle shock is much hotter than the Compton temperature, so Compton scattering cools it, shifts the radiation to higher photon energies, and adds X-ray energy tens to hundreds of times faster than thermal emission.”

analysis.title_zh: GRB X射线耀斑的能谱性质
analysis.reason: 该工作利用 Swift/XRT 历时 10 年的大样本（206 个 GRB 共 521 个耀斑），系统开展了耀斑前、耀斑期与耀斑后的时间分辨能谱拟合与统计，证实了耀斑能谱在耀斑期显著硬化、连续耀斑随时间软化，且系统性软于瞬时辐射，为 GRB 中心引擎晚期重新激活产生内部激波的物理模型提供了重要观测限制。
analysis.result: 通过对 521 个 X 射线耀斑进行吸收幂律谱拟合与统计分析：(1) WT 模式与 PC 模式的光子指数 $\Gamma$ 分布高度一致，峰值中心分别为 $x_c = 1.85 \pm 0.02$ 与 $x_c = 1.86 \pm 0.02$（全样本高斯峰 $x_c = 1.85 \pm 0.01$，均值 1.94）；(2) 耀斑各阶段光谱演化显著，耀斑期峰值 $x_c = 1.82 \pm 0.02$ 相比耀斑后期 $x_c = 1.94 \pm 0.03$ 发生显著硬化（配对 $t$ 检验 $t = -3.700, p = 2.655 \times 10^{-4}$），且在多耀斑事件中，光子指数随峰值时间 $t_{\rm peak}$ 呈递增软化趋势；(3) 吸收柱密度在耀斑前期与耀斑期基本保持恒定（$\log(N_{\rm H}/{\rm cm^{-2}}) = 21.71 \pm 0.08$ 与 $21.71 \pm 0.04$），但耀斑后显著降低至 $21.58 \pm 0.04$；(4) 耀斑整体能谱显著软于瞬时辐射（瞬时辐射幂律模型峰值 $x_c = 1.62 \pm 0.03$，截止幂律峰值 $x_c = 1.46 \pm 0.02$）；X 射线闪耀斑最软，经典伽玛暴最硬（$\Gamma_{\rm XRF} \approx 2.15 > \Gamma_{\rm XRR} \approx 1.87 > \Gamma_{\rm C-GRB} \approx 1.79$）。
analysis.problem: 探究伽马射线暴（GRB）X 射线耀斑的辐射机制与能谱时变规律，厘清耀斑能谱是源自中心引擎晚期重启驱动的内部激波还是外部激波余辉演化，以及耀斑与瞬时辐射在辐射物理上的内在联系与差异。
analysis.method: 选取 2005 年 4 月至 2015 年 3 月 Swift/XRT 观测的 206 个 GRB（521 个耀斑），依据时间切片提取耀斑前、耀斑期及耀斑后阶段数据；在 XSPEC 中采用吸收幂律模型 $\texttt{phabs} \times \texttt{zphabs} \times \texttt{powerlaw}$，固定银河吸收柱密度，将本征柱密度 $N_{\rm H,int}$ 与光子指数 $\Gamma$ 设为自由参数，采用 Cash 统计量处理泊松计数并应用 K-S 检验与配对 $t$ 检验评估演化特征。

III.2 Temporal Evolution of the Photon Index in X-Ray Flares: “the photon index of X-ray flares increases progressively with peak time, indicating a spectral softening trend as the peak time increases.”

analysis.title_zh: FRB 20210601A：重复FRB极端时间聚集性揭示隐藏的阵发性重复暴子群
analysis.reason: 文章报告了 CHIME/FRB 发现的具有迄今最高瞬时暴发率的极端聚集重复源 FRB 20210601A，在仅 106.5 s 内暴发 9 次（主瓣归一化 $\gtrsim 21$ 次）且长期跨年静默（$>320\text{ hr}$ 曝光），为联系非重复暴与重复暴的阵发机制及磁星风暴模型提供了关键观测约束。
analysis.result: FRB 20210601A 在单次中天过境的 $\Delta T = 106.5\;\mathrm{s}$ 内集中产生 9 次暴发，峰值暴发率 $\langle\lambda\rangle = (N-1)/\Delta T = 0.075\;\mathrm{bursts\;s^{-1}}$，等效至主瓣增益下爆发数 $\gtrsim 21$ 次；最亮暴各向同性峰值光度达 $L_{\rm iso} \sim 2.3 \times 10^{43}\;\mathrm{erg\;s^{-1}}$，9 次暴发总能量 $E_{\rm tot} \sim 2.2 \times 10^{41}\;\mathrm{erg}$（相对于 $B=10^{15}\;\mathrm{G}$ 磁星储备满足 $E_{\rm tot}/E_{\rm mag} \sim 10^{-6}$）；宿主环境参数测得 $\mathrm{DM_{excess}} \sim 360\;\mathrm{pc\;cm^{-3}}$、$\tau(600\;\mathrm{MHz}) \lesssim 0.37\;\mathrm{ms}$，去红移旋转量 $|\mathrm{RM_{excess}}| \sim 150-340\;\mathrm{rad\;m^{-2}}$，表明其介质与常规重复暴相当。
analysis.reading_entry: IV.2 Peak Activity and Implications for Energy Budget
analysis.problem: 快速射电暴中单次暴发源（one-offs）与重复暴发源的本质物理联系尚未厘清，传统平稳泊松过程无法解释部分仅被探测到一次却表现出极端局域聚集发作的物理起源。
analysis.method: 利用 CHIME/FRB 搜索与基带重定相数据提取位置、散射与线偏振/RM 特征；使用天顶仪赤纬相关曝光 $d(\delta)=E_0/\cos(\delta)$（$E_0 \sim 2.2\;\mathrm{min}$）建立天区泊松似然模型，并结合通量分布 $N(>F) \propto F^{\rm index}$ 与波束响应进行主瓣通量和总体数目贝叶斯推断。

II Observations: “On 2021 June 1, CHIME/FRB detected a series of nine bursts from FRB 20210601A within 106.5 s, all above the real-time detection threshold of S/N$\geq 8.5$.”
